keyword_retrieval: Fictional study note: Keyword retrieval baseline. The system ranks paper notes using overlap between query tokens and document tokens. Exact vocabulary matches are easy to inspect and require no embedding service. Synonyms may be missed when the query and document use different words. This teaching example reports no benchmark scores or participant count.
dense_retrieval: Fictional study note: Dense retrieval prototype. The system represents research questions and paper passages as embedding vectors. Semantic similarity can retrieve passages that use different vocabulary. Retrieval quality depends on the embedding model and the collection used for evaluation. This teaching example provides no shared benchmark against keyword retrieval and no numerical performance results.
hybrid_retrieval: Fictional study note: Hybrid retrieval proposal. The system combines keyword retrieval candidates with dense retrieval candidates. A reranker orders the combined candidates before the assistant generates a response. Combining methods introduces extra computation and configuration choices. The proposal does not include an ablation experiment that isolates the contribution of each component.
grounded_generation: Fictional study note: Evidence-grounded generation. A research assistant receives retrieved passages before drafting an answer. Each factual claim should cite the identifier of a supporting document. Missing evidence should be reported rather than replaced with an invented result. The presence of a citation alone does not prove that the cited passage supports the claim.
evaluation_protocol: Fictional study note: Evaluation protocol. Retrieval quality can be evaluated with a set of research questions and human-labeled relevant passages. A controlled comparison should use the same collection and question set for all retrieval methods. Answer evaluation should separately inspect factual support, citation accuracy and abstention when evidence is missing. This proposed protocol contains no executed evaluation results or participant recruitment details.
